open_questions: For nextjs_14_next_swc_wasm_removed:c2_depends_on_wasm_swc - The official documentation does not provide details about which specific environments, architectures, or configurations relied on the WASM target. This makes it difficult to create a concrete, testable condition. Users should test builds in their target environments to determine impact.

The upgrade path from Next.js 12 to 14 includes changes from Next.js 13. Human reviewer should verify whether users need explicit guidance about whether they should upgrade 12->13->14 or can go directly to 14.
